purpose: Executable simulator-fidelity and model-discrepancy denominator for preventing simulator, synthetic-data, digital-twin, model-calibration, and generative-model support from becoming candidate identity.

simulator_fidelity_rows.simulator_fidelity_class: route-local simulator / synthetic data fidelity denominator
simulator_fidelity_rows.simulator_or_generator_object: Route-local simulator, generative model, numerical model, digital twin, synthetic-data generator, benchmark environment, survey/catalog simulator, detector simulator, or metadata-only generator invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
simulator_fidelity_rows.fidelity_or_model_discrepancy_test: Declare governing equations or generative rules, simulator version, calibration parameters, model-discrepancy term, validation target, synthetic/real split, stochastic seed policy, and residual misfit before spending simulation-fidelity language.
simulator_fidelity_rows.validation_target: Target may be a public record, laboratory record, benchmark distribution, catalog/map statistic, waveform population, compactification scan, lattice/sampler output, or route-local surrogate; target locality must be declared.
simulator_fidelity_rows.residual_gap: A simulator can reproduce selected observables while remaining misspecified, overcalibrated, non-identifiable, non-transferable, or blind to candidate-distinguishing residuals.
simulator_fidelity_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer physical truth, public-record closure, prediction, or candidate-native support from simulator fidelity alone.

simulator_fidelity_rows.simulator_fidelity_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; no physical simulator-fidelity credit
simulator_fidelity_rows.simulator_or_generator_object: Archive package metadata, generated summaries, manifests, and provenance surfaces only.
simulator_fidelity_rows.fidelity_or_model_discrepancy_test: Metadata can make simulator claims easier to audit, but it is not a simulator, generator, or fidelity test.
simulator_fidelity_rows.validation_target: Package integrity and restart surfaces only; no physical or public-record target.
simulator_fidelity_rows.residual_gap: Clean metadata does not validate a simulator or close model discrepancy.
simulator_fidelity_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer simulator fidelity, prediction, or candidate support from package metadata.
